programs.title: The First 48
programs.desc: In Tulsa, a late-night shootout leads investigators to a woman from the victim's past. Meanwhile, in Georgia, detectives must decide if a Marine veteran's shooter is telling the truth or using a self-defence claim to cover up a murder.

programs.title: American Ripper
programs.desc: An investigation into the gruesome details of Holmes' infamous Murder Castle leads to the discovery that he may have been killing victims all over Chicago and beyond; while a report surfaces that the Ripper may have killed in the U.S.

programs.title: Oz Off Road TV
programs.desc: The crew go mining underground in White Cliffs, call into one of Australia's most famous pubs before rocking on at the country's largest outback music festival, The Mundi Mundi Bash.

programs.title: My Way
programs.desc: Tim Blackwell introduces inspirational Aussies, each with a unique story about how they live their best life. It's a lifestyle program that allows people to tell their own stories firsthand to say, 'I'm doing this My Way'.
